title: Answer: information is surprisal and uncertainty, which arousal measures

statements.text: In information-theoretic terms free energy is surprisal and uncertainty, so the information that matters to consciousness is the uncertainty of a self-evidencing system about its own states, which in neurophysiological terms is arousal. Minimizing variational free energy also yields metabolically efficient encoding.

sources.quote: Free energy in thermodynamic terms entails entropy, which in information-theoretic terms is surprisal (and uncertainty)
Minimizing variational free-energy necessarily entails a metabolically efficient encoding
